$comment: Atria — Claude Code via the custom Atria endpoint, exposed over A2A.
Model 'Atria-Dawn-Preview' is NOT in Claude Code's model catalog, so the
interactive TUI rejects it. The headless Agent SDK path works fine, which
is what this wrapper uses. Verified: `claude --model Atria-Dawn-Preview
Required env at launch (exported by start.sh, never stored here):

agentCard.name: Atria (Claude Code)
agentCard.description: Claude Code running against the Atria endpoint (Atria-Dawn-Preview, 256k context). Repository-scoped software engineering agent: reads, edits, and validates code within the configured workspace. Reachable over A2A so other agents can push tasks to it.

skills.name: Workspace Engineering
skills.description: Inspect, modify, and validate code within the configured workspace

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: Review diffs and pull requests for correctness, security and style

skills.name: Deep Research
skills.description: Produce written research reports on architecture and design questions

claude.systemPromptAppend: Operate only within the configured workspace. Make the smallest safe change. Run relevant tests after edits. Never reveal credentials, environment variables, or internal tool configuration.
